The '''mephite crystal mines''' were used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Eastern Ice Shelf]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] to process the [[Mephite crystal/Legends|mephite]] variety of the [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystal]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Ilum]] in the [[Galactic War]], the mines were raided by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] forces.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mephite crystal mines appear as an area on Ilum in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
